mapper.select: SELECT fr.request_id AS requestId, fr.from_user_id AS fromUserId, u1.username AS fromUsername, u1.avatar AS fromAvatar, fr.to_user_id AS toUserId, u2.username AS toUsername, u2.avatar AS toAvatar, fr.message, fr.status, fr.created_at AS createdAt, fr.handled_at AS handledAt FROM friend_request fr INNER JOIN user u1 ON fr.from_user_id = u1.user_id INNER JOIN user u2 ON fr.to_user_id = u2.user_id WHERE fr.to_user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY fr.created_at DESC
